title: チーム総合力アップ・金色の差し入れ

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Excellent work, Trainer! What you've achieved with your team is truly incredible!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Seeing the runners grow this much… It's so touching!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see all the things they'll accomplish, so I brought a little something to help. Please, take this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The thoughtful gift from Tazuna gets the team extra fired up to win the Unity Cup!
